reason: This rule suggests that if two individuals are sitting in an airport terminal, then one of them feels bored. This aligns with the contradiction pattern of "Factual" and "Contextual" because the premise is factual (both individuals are in the same location), and the conclusion about feeling bored is contextual, which can lead to contradictions in social settings where feelings can vary despite similar circumstances.
reflecting_rules: - 1. Q[Individual1, Individual2](sitting_in(Individual1, airport_terminal) ∧ sitting_in(Individual2, airport_terminal) → feeling(Bored, Individual1))
